They perform synchronized arm waves and leg steps while smiling directly at the camera. The background features a metal bridge railing and distant city skyline lights under a dark sky. (2) The dancers turn 180 degrees away from the camera, whipping their long hair in a circular motion before turning back to face the lens. They continue the high-energy choreography with precise hand gestures and synchronized hip movements. The lighting is bright and focused directly on the subjects, creating a sharp contrast against the dark urban background and the gray concrete ground. (3) The routine concludes with the duo forming heart shapes with their arms raised above their heads and then performing a series of rapid hand slides down their torsos while swaying. Their facial expressions remain joyful and engaged throughout the performance. The camera remains completely static, capturing their full-body movements within the center of the vertical frame.
